fields.label: FY Opening Balance Source
fields.description: From Ledger: read from the company's actual Bank/Cash GL balance as of the fiscal year start — the statement then reconciles by construction. Manual Override: use the value below instead, for the first year of use before ledger history exists.

fields.label: Residual Warning Threshold
fields.description: A reconciliation residual larger than this share of the period's total bank turnover is flagged on the statement rather than shown as an ordinary line — the signal that a line is missing, overlapping, or mis-bound.
